datasetSources.name: Citywide Public Computer Centers
datasetSources.agency: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI)
datasetSources.licenseAndAttribution: NYC Open Data terms; attribute NYC OTI; agency-specific notices override general terms.
datasetSources.reuse: Public facility records. No private personal data ingested.
datasetSources.filter: calendar_year = 2026 AND status = 'Currently open'; 3 entries excluded by coordinate/address bounds; administrative status is NOT live business hours.
datasetSources.concerns: Some sites have age or membership eligibility restrictions; no promise of free walk-in access.

datasetSources.name: Health Facility General Information

datasetSources.licenseAndAttribution: OPEN-NY lawful reuse under state terms; attribute NYS Department of Health; additional content-specific conditions take precedence.
datasetSources.reuse: Only 'HOSP' records in NYC counties; no claim all health facilities are hospitals.
datasetSources.coverage: NYS dataset filtered to Bronx, Kings, New York, Queens, Richmond
datasetSources.filter: fac_desc_short = HOSP; NYC counties; one record excluded for missing/out-of-bounds coordinates
datasetSources.concerns: The raw source contains repeated facility IDs across records; local display IDs use row indexes. Not a live services or operating-hours feed.
